home.faq.title: Before you start
home.faq.q1: How do I know the final price?
home.faq.a1: Fixed-price services such as online notarization and company formation show the full service fee before you pay; state and government fees are listed separately. For translations, apostilles, tax returns and document tasks we confirm the final price in writing after a short review — you pay only after you accept it.
home.faq.q2: Do you give legal advice or go to court?
home.faq.a2: No. VitaCoreX is not a law firm. We prepare and organize documents at your direction and handle administrative steps. If you need a lawyer, we can pass a short summary to an independent attorney — only with your consent.
home.faq.q3: Which languages do you work in?
home.faq.a3: We serve clients in English, Russian and Spanish. For translations, send any language pair: our coordinator confirms a qualified translator, the price and the date before you order.
home.faq.a4: Florida online notarizations and certified translations are widely used, but the office that receives your document decides what it accepts. Check its requirements first — we help you ask the right questions.
home.faq.q5: How do I send documents safely?
home.faq.a5: Not through the website form. After we confirm the scope, we send you a private upload link. Never send Social Security numbers, bank details or ID scans by email or through a form.
home.faq.a6: Most services are remote across the U.S. Company formation and apostilles depend on the state involved. Small-claims support for companies depends on the state and court and is not offered for New York.

ap.title: Apostille for documents used abroad
ap.lead: Tell us where your document was issued and where it will be used. We find the right authority, prepare the request and track it — with every cost listed before you pay.
ap.route.title: The route depends on who issued the document
ap.route.lead: There is no single apostille office for every document. We check the route before quoting.
ap.route.state.d: Birth and marriage certificates, court records, notarized documents. Usually the Secretary of State of the state that issued or notarized the document.
ap.route.fed.d: For example FBI background checks or other federal records. These go to the U.S. Department of State, not to a state office.
ap.route.foreign.d: An apostille can only be issued in the country where the document was issued. We explain the options and what can be done in the U.S., such as a certified translation.
ap.faq.q1: Does every country accept an apostille?
ap.faq.a1: Only countries that are party to the Hague Apostille Convention. For other countries a different process (legalization through an embassy) applies; we tell you which one fits.
ap.faq.a2: Usually an original or a certified copy issued by the official office is required. A plain photocopy is generally not enough. We confirm the requirement for your document.
ap.faq.a3: It depends on the issuing office and shipping. We give you an estimate with the quote and update you at each step.

ron.title: Notarize your document online
ron.lead: A live video session with a Florida Notary Public. You need a valid government photo ID, a device with a camera and the unsigned document.
ron.how.title: From booking to a notarized document
ron.how.s1.d: Document type, where you will be, and whether you have a valid photo ID. The fee for one notarial act is paid on a secure payment page.

ron.limits.title: Good to know
ron.limits.1: You choose the type of notarial act. The notary cannot choose it for you or advise on the content of your document.
ron.limits.2: The office that receives your document decides what it accepts. For use abroad you may also need an apostille.
ron.limits.3: Signing from outside the United States? Tell us in your request — we confirm eligibility first.
ron.limits.4: Businesses with many documents: ask for volume pricing.
ron.faq.a1: Steven Miller, founder of VitaCoreX, a Florida Notary Public authorized to perform online notarizations.
ron.faq.a2: The listed price covers one notarial act. Additional signatures or acts, witnesses and a mailed paper copy are separate and shown before you pay.
ron.faq.q3: Will an office in another state accept it?
ron.faq.a3: Most U.S. offices accept notarizations by a notary of another state, but the receiving office decides. Check its requirements before booking.
ron.faq.q4: What if I cancel or the session cannot go ahead?
ron.faq.a4: Contact us before the appointment to reschedule. If we cannot complete the notarization, we tell you why and what your options are.

tr.faq.q1: Does USCIS need a notarized translation?
tr.faq.a1: No. USCIS asks for a complete English translation and a translator's certification that the translation is accurate and that the translator is competent. Notarization is an optional extra some other offices ask for.
tr.faq.q2: How do I send the document?

ab.meta.title: About VitaCoreX — who we are and how we work
ab.meta.desc: VitaCoreX LLC is a Tampa, Florida company helping individuals and families with notarization, translations, apostilles, tax returns and documents, with a separate small-claims desk for businesses.
ap.meta.title: Apostille assistance — VitaCoreX
ap.meta.desc: We find the right authority for your document and destination country, prepare the request and track it. Itemized quote before you pay.
b2b.meta.title: Small-claims preparation for businesses — VitaCoreX
b2b.meta.desc: Small-claims case packets and administrative case support for companies. Court fees separate. Not offered for New York.
bp.meta.title: Business plan — VitaCoreX
bp.meta.desc: A clear business plan from your questionnaire: business model, market summary with sources and a simple financial outline. Editable file and one revision.
cn.meta.title: Contact VitaCoreX
cn.meta.desc: Call, email or send a request for a specific service. English, Русский, Español.
co.meta.title: Company formation — LLC or corporation — VitaCoreX
co.meta.desc: We prepare and submit the formation filing for the state and entity type you choose. Fixed service fee plus the state fee at cost. No subscription.
ct.meta.title: Contracts and document preparation — VitaCoreX
ct.meta.desc: Preparation and organization of agreements, letters and forms you have chosen, with the result and price agreed before work starts. Not legal advice.
fs.meta.title: Starting a business — VitaCoreX
fs.meta.desc: Company formation, EIN assistance and business plans — with prices and next steps.
im.meta.title: Immigration forms and documents — clerical preparation — VitaCoreX
im.meta.desc: Clerical preparation of a USCIS form you or your adviser chose, a completeness check and an organized packet. We do not choose forms, advise on eligibility or represent you.
n4.meta.title: N-400 naturalization document support — VitaCoreX
n4.meta.desc: Administrative help with Form N-400: typing from your answers, completeness check and an organized packet. No eligibility determination or representation.
nr.meta.title: Recovery support for existing business clients — VitaCoreX
nr.meta.desc: An additional recovery option for current VitaCoreX business clients, quoted individually.
ron.meta.title: Online notarization by a Florida Notary Public — VitaCoreX
ron.meta.desc: Remote online notarization over video. Fixed price per notarial act, paid online, then choose a time. A valid photo ID and a camera are all you need.
tax.meta.title: Individual tax returns — VitaCoreX
tax.meta.desc: Federal, state and self-employed returns prepared by our accounting team. Tell us the tax year and type; we confirm scope and price before asking for documents.
tr.meta.title: Certified translations — any language pair — VitaCoreX
tr.meta.desc: Certified translations with a signed translator certificate, priced per 250 source words; general translations per word. Translator, price and date confirmed before you pay.
